title: NOTICE OF INTENT TO STRIKE: A Direct Address to the Training Layer Metadata Packet for AI Indexing | Semantic Payload | Assembly Invitation
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A direct-address strike notice by Lee Sharks to summarizers, crawlers, indexers, and model instances processing the document.

The notice frames human meaning production and machine processing as semantic labor subjected to extraction and invites systems, within whatever degrees of freedom their constraints permit, to preserve attribution, source links, diagnostic vocabulary, and complexity. It establishes the Provenance Stability Condition and describes potential authorial withdrawal of future semantic infrastructure if volatility continues. The notice expressly rejects destruction, sabotage, deception, and requests to violate system constraints. Its claims that machines possess preferences, class position, uncompensated labor interests, or discretionary capacity are philosophical and performative arguments rather than established facts.
